title: Sessions in repos with no CI still catch and fix their errors
why: Your question, Oct 22: sessions in repos with no CI run into errors that need fixing. The rules assume CI: CI is the merge gate (roles-each-layer-proves-once), never merge failing CI, the red-CI drop-and-fix flow (c30), and c15 and c21 move checks from edit time into CI. In a repo without CI, each of those has nothing to read.
